verdicts.label: TRUE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: On 23 August 2023, India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed its Vikram lander near the Moon's south pole, making it the first country to achieve this feat.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple reputable news sources (PBS, VOA, The Guardian) and a fact-checking organization (BOOM Fact Check) confirm that India's Chandrayaan-3 mission landed near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023. All sources corroborate that this made India the first country to successfully land a spacecraft in that specific lunar region. There is no credible evidence contradicting this claim.
